name: Scott Betts Training Stable
tagline: Home of 2018 Meadows Horse of the Year Phoenix Warrior N
story: Harness racing runs deep in the Betts family. Scott's grandfather trained and drove Standardbreds, and his father was a veterinarian who worked on them, so he grew up around the sport.

Scott studied biology and entrepreneurship in college, and it was his grandfather who suggested buying a $5,000 fillies and mares claimer. That first horse turned into a career. He has been training since 2014, working for others in the summers before going out on his own, and built the stable from a single horse into a barn at The Meadows that regularly sits near the top of the trainer standings.

Scott is hands-on with every horse in the barn, and he is a skilled blacksmith who does his own shoeing. It is a family operation: his brother Tim works in the barn and handles the business side, and his mother helps with barn work and errands.

The barn's best-known name is Phoenix Warrior N, the 2018 Meadows Horse of the Year. Today the stable keeps a tight group of pacers racing at The Meadows and Northfield Park, with new horses joining all the time.
phoenix: Phoenix Warrior N was the 2018 Meadows Horse of the Year, and the horse that put the Betts barn on the map.
He gave Scott, his family and everyone who cheered him home some of the best moments this sport can offer. Fast, tough and full of heart, he was a champion in every sense of the word.
Thank you, Phoenix. You will never be forgotten.

honor.name: Our Honor Defend
honor.sub: Lost In Time filly · trained by Scott Betts
paragraphs: Our Honor Defend was a Lost In Time filly trained by Scott and co-owned by Scott, Keith Gisser and Kerry McCullough.

On October 4, 2025 she won the sophomore filly pace at the Buckeye Stallion Series Finals at MGM Northfield Park, coming from sixth at the three-quarter pole to win by a nose at 24-1 in 1:54.2, with Case Bateson in the sulky.
honor.source: Record as reported before the 2025 Buckeye Stallion Series Finals. Source: Harnesslink and US Trotting News.
